sentences.en: There is an advertising balloon flying above the department store.
sentences.zh: 百货商店上方飘着一个广告气球。

sentences.en: It may be unwise of you to advertise your presence.
sentences.zh: 你公开露面可能会有些不明智。

sentences.en: It was advertised as a second edition in the newspapers.
sentences.zh: 报纸上宣传这是第二版。
